fields.rationale: Adjoint state introduced to evaluate the shape derivative; it inherits the homogeneous Dirichlet condition on Gamma_3.

test_functions.name: delta_u

characteristic_function.rationale: Strong chi=1 in material and weak chi=0.1 in void as extracted.

optimization_config.rationale: Level-set topology optimization parameters for a unit cube design domain [0,1]^3: mesh sizes one percent to ten percent of the side length, small diffusion regularization, initial speed 1e-2, 30 iterations, and initial solid sphere of radius 0.25 centered at (0.5,0,0.5) so that it touches the Dirichlet face Gamma_3. Boundary labels correspond to the designed cube faces; label 3 is fixed because it carries the Dirichlet condition.
